title: OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 billing fix: how much sooner each model hits your plan’s limit
intro: Slide across the models to see what OpenAI’s fix changes compared with last week, and what it does not, as stated by OpenAI’s Tibo Sottiaux.
note: Figures are OpenAI’s own, from Tibo Sottiaux’s post of 26 November 2026, as reported by BleepingComputer. “40% faster” and “25% faster” describe how soon you reach your limit compared with last week; OpenAI has not said exactly how this is measured, so it is not shown here as a number of tasks. The reset expiry is BleepingComputer’s observation in ChatGPT’s settings. Nothing here was measured independently.
